text:
nina: FYI CS reported several customers hitting surprising v1 quota after the new migration banner. Their frontends autoplay the banner CTA which sometimes triggers a retry flow that drops `x-api-version`.
omar: Logs match that. We're seeing rapid duplicate client_request_id pairs where the second lacks the header and gets routed to v1. Big spike around 11:10 PT for a handful of tenants.
tess: Quick thought: shadow-route the header-less requests to v2 for a short canary cohort, compare outputs, and if equal-ish promote the route. That avoids billing shock while validating functional parity.
liam: Shadow routing is doable but we must be careful about token counting. Shadowed requests still consume v2 tokens unless we explicitly suppress charging. Billing needs a tag.
fiona: Billing: we can zero-rate requests annotated with `X-Redwood-Compat-Tag: shadow-exempt` for up to 14 days for rollout. Need runtime to reliably inject that header only when we own the decision. Also need an audit trail.
omar: Runtime sketch: if missing header and UA suggests sdk>=1.5, then run both routes in shadow mode; compare outputs by a fuzzy-equality check (e.g., normalized text similarity > 0.95). If similar, respond with v2 result and emit `X-Redwood-Compat-Tag: shadow-exempt` to billing. Pseudo-rule:
```
compat_shadowing:
  when:
    missing_header: true
    user_agent_min: "redwood-sdk/1.5.0"
  action:
    execute_shadow: v2
    compare: fuzzy_similarity>0.95
    on_match:
      respond_with: v2
      emit_header: X-Redwood-Compat-Tag: shadow-exempt
    sampling: canary-tenants-only
    ff: compat_shadow_canary
```
tess: Couple of safety notes: 1) Make sampling tenant-configurable in console (Routing -> Compatibility -> Shadow canary list). 2) Keep the fuzzy check conservative to avoid false positives.
liam: Operational ask: don't change model selection or quantization in the path. Make the routing decision upstream and keep inference unchanged. Add alerts: shadow mismatch rate > 0.1% or v2 p99 latency delta > 300ms.
fiona: We'll need a reconciliation job to find zero-rated shadow requests and later bill or credit if we change policy. I'll own the reporting query.
nina: UX: We should also change the banner CTA copy to "Retry preserving headers" and link to SDK patch notes. That reduces accidental drops. If customers want auto-fallback, offer a tenant-level toggle: "Enable safe auto-upgrade (shadow & promote)". Default OFF.
omar: Implementation plan: 1) Console: add canary tenant list + auto-upgrade toggle (Tess owner). 2) Runtime: feature-flagged shadowing with header injection (me). 3) Billing: honor shadow-exempt tag and produce reconciliation report (Fiona). 4) Observability: dashboard tiles for shadow_matches, shadow_mismatches, v1_fallback_rate, compat_tag_ratio (Liam).
tess: I'll add console controls and copy; default off and explicit explainer tooltips. Also add a short help doc link.
liam: We'll add smoothing for v1 fallback quotas: token-bucket per-tenant with short grace refill to avoid immediate 429 cascades. That reduces client retry loops.
fiona: Approvals: billing needs a temporary credit policy for any unexpected charge during the canary, and a log of `X-Redwood-Compat-Tag` to tie to invoices.
nina: Rollout window proposal: canary tenants today 18:00-19:30 PT; monitor 2 hours; then slow roll if OK. Emergency kill switches: FF off + console toggle revert.
console-bot: feature_flag created: compat_shadow_canary by omar at 1780012400
omar: I'll instrument a safe-sampling circuit so only 1% of org traffic hits the shadow path initially. Increase by tenant opt-in.
tess: Also recommend a one-time SDK advisory: release patch and add header-preservation checks. Link that in banner.
liam: Add alerts and an automated rollback playbook entry. If shadow_mismatch > 0.05% for 30m, FF off.
fiona: I'll prepare the billing reconciliation query and a short REDACTED CSV export for finance.
nina: Thanks team. After canary we'll pack a short status note for customers impacted and list any credits applied. Keep comms minimal but clear.
